fields.description: Build a subscription service for a sandbox product. No real billing or payment processor is involved.
acceptance_criteria: POST /subscriptions creates a basic (500 cents) or premium (900 cents) subscription
Require customer_id, plan, and an Idempotency-Key header
Repeated identical requests reuse the subscription; changed payload with the same key returns 409
The sandbox X-Customer-Id identity must own reads and cancellation; other owners receive 403
Invalid inputs return 400, missing subscriptions return 404
Subscription lookup has no artificial delay
